# Required check manifest for the vizra META repo (ADR-002 § CI fan-in and
# merge queue; docs/META_REPO.md §7).
#
# `ci-required` reads this file and fails unless every listed job concluded
# `success` on the head SHA. Anything else — failure, cancellation, timeout,
# skip, never-ran — fails the aggregate, so a lane that silently stops running
# blocks the merge instead of disappearing.
#
# One job name per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# CODEOWNERS names the owner for this file, but CODEOWNERS is advisory; the war
# room's verifier-gated merge is the only review. It must not be edited in the
# same PR as the thing it guards.
#
# A PR may ADD a lane here. It may not REMOVE the floor lane — `validate` —
# because this manifest is read from the checkout under test, so a PR could
# otherwise stop gating itself by deleting a line. The floor lives in
# scripts/ci-required-guard.sh, not here.
# RETIRING A LANE (VZ-CI-001). A lane the base commit lists may leave this file
# only if this file then carries a line of exactly this form, kept forever:
#     # tombstone: <lane> retired <YYYY-MM-DD> because <reason>
# scripts/check-required-tombstones.sh (run by `ci-required`) compares against
# the base manifest from git and fails on a removal or commented-out lane with
# no tombstone, a tombstone missing its date or reason, one for a lane the base
# never had, one for a lane still listed or for the floor, and on deleting an
# earlier tombstone. It fails closed when the base manifest cannot be read.
# Entries must be bare job names: no trailing comment, no "optional" marker.
#
# docs/META_REPO.md §7 names three target lanes for this repo — `validate`,
# `bundle` and `boot`. Only `validate` exists today. The compose topology
# landed in meta #4, and `validate` renders and asserts it, but there is still
# no installer, no bundle builder and no booted stack, so `bundle` and `boot`
# have nothing to run against. They are NOT listed here, because listing a
# lane that does not exist would make `ci-required` wait forever for a check
# nobody defined. They are added when the slices that create them land.

validate
